blurb: Offers family law mediation sessions, parent education classes online, and volunteer opportunities in mediation and restorative dialogue. Mediation sessions are 90 minutes; parent education classes are 3.5 hours online via Zoom. Volunteers support small claims, community mediation, and restorative dialogue programs with training and mentoring.
extraNote: Fees payable before mediation session begins; cancellation with less than 48 hours notice incurs full session fee · Parent Education Program fee is nonrefundable; 24 hours notice required for cancellation to avoid re-paying · Fee waivers available for mediation and parent education with court affidavit of indigency · Participation in Parent Education is public record, but class dates kept confidential for safety
